script: Hi, I'm Cheryl Clark, from Invoingo. Let me show you your invoice maker on the go.
Here are my invoices, with balances and statuses in one place. I can open a record, or start a new invoice.
And MioBot is right here. I can ask about an invoice, then prepare a reminder. I review the draft before choosing to send it.
Client details, saved items and payment records stay close at hand. Alex's invoice is marked paid, for one thousand, three hundred and two dollars.
That's Invoingo. Your invoices, wherever you are. Invoice maker on the go.
